headline: Brazil Unemployment Rate Falls to 5.2% in Quarter Ended September
summary: Brazil's unemployment rate dropped to 5.2% in the three months through September, marking the lowest rate for a third quarter since 2012, while the employed population reached a record 103.6 million.
why: Labor market indicators are critical metrics for assessing domestic demand, inflationary pressures, and monetary policy trajectories in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Lower unemployment and record employment figures indicate strengthening domestic economic activity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Better-than-expected labor market data influences investor sentiment regarding domestic economic resilience and central bank policy.
